**[00:43:26.000] Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora** (asr-000286)

**[02:35:40.700] Rep. Joseph S. Tan** (asr-002240-split-3)  
Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleagues, magandang araw sa ating lahat. Kapag po pinag-usapan natin ang irigasyon, hindi lamang po kanal, dam at istruktura ang ating pinag-uusapan. Ang pinag-uusapan po natin ay tubig na nagbibigay-buhay sa ating mga sakahan,

**[02:36:00.000] Rep. Joseph S. Tan** (asr-002241)  
ani na nagbibigay kabuhayan sa ating mga magsasaka at pagkain na inilalagay natin sa hapag ng bawat pamilyang Pilipino. Bilang kinatawan ng isang agricultural district, personal ko pong nakikita at naririnig ang mga hamon ng ating mga magsasaka. Kapag walang sapat na tubig, walang sapat na ani. Kapag mababa ang ani, mababa ang kita ng magsasaka.

**[02:36:30.000] Rep. Joseph S. Tan** (asr-002242)  
At kapag humina ang produksyon ng ating mga bukid, tayong lahat ang apektado sa presyo ng bigas, gulay at iba pang mga pagkain. Kaya ang budget ng National Irrigation Administration ay hindi lamang budget para sa isang government corporation. It is an investment in our farmers, our country, and ultimately in our nation?s food security.

**[02:37:00.000] Rep. Joseph S. Tan** (asr-002243)  
Mr. Speaker, the challenge before us is clear. We need to expand irrigation to agricultural areas that still depend heavily on rainfall. We need to rehabilitate aging and damaged irrigation facilities. We need to modernize our system so that water reaches farms more efficiently and increasingly. We need irrigation infrastructure that can withstand drought, floods, typhoons and the growing effects of climate change.

**[02:37:30.000] Rep. Joseph S. Tan** (asr-002244)  
But funding alone is not enough. Every peso that Congress provides for irrigation must translate into actual hectares irrigated, reliable water supply, higher agricultural productivity and better income for our farmers. We expect NIA to ensure that projects are properly planned,

**[02:38:00.000] Rep. Joseph S. Tan** (asr-002245)  
implementation-ready and completed on time. We also expect NIA to strengthen its partnership with our irrigators? associations. Hindi lamang beneficiaries ang ating mga irrigators at magsasaka. Partner sila ng pamahalaan. They know their farms. They understand their irrigation system, and they know where government intervention is most urgently needed.

**[04:38:09.760] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004129)

**[04:38:10.760] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004130)  
With the indulgence po of the Honorable Speaker,

**[04:38:16.020] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004131)  
Mr. Speaker and distinguished colleagues in this August Chamber,

**[04:38:20.260] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004132)  
I rise today and it is a distinct honor for me to sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget

**[04:38:26.480] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004133)  
of the Department of Agriculture, including its attached agencies and government corporations

**[04:38:32.280] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004134)  
as contained in the National Expenditure Program.

**[04:38:35.600] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004135)  
And the proposed budget of the Department stands at

**[04:38:38.300] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004136)  
198.45 billion,

**[04:38:41.320] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004137)  
or about 17.25

**[04:38:43.880] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004138)  
billion, or 8% lower than the 215.69 billion appropriated last year.

**[04:38:51.460] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004139)  
Mr. Speaker, we enter this budget year with encouraging evidence that our investments are beginning to bear fruit.

**[04:38:58.660] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004140)  
In 2025, the Philippine Statistics Authority reported that the agriculture, forestry, and fishing sector grew by 3.1%,

**[04:39:07.940] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004141)  
reversing the 1.5%

**[04:39:09.860] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004142)  
contraction recorded in 2024.

**[04:39:13.340] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004143)  
And the momentum

**[04:39:14.800] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004144)  
continues to this current year.

**[04:39:16.900] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004145)  
In the second quarter alone, the value of agriculture and fisheries production increased by 2.9% year-on-year,

**[04:39:24.740] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004146)  
reaching 452.22 billion at constant 2018 prices.

**[04:39:32.540] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004147)  
Crops, livestock, poultry, and fisheries all reported increases in the value of production.

**[04:39:37.400] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004148)  
We have also seen concrete progress on the ground.

**[04:39:42.720] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004149)  
Through programs such as Rice for All, 20 Pesos Rice, Kadiwa, enhanced buffer stocking and support provided under the Rice Tariffication Law, the government has continued to address the twin objectives of keeping food accessible to consumers while providing better support to our producers.

**[04:40:02.040] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004150)  
However, Mr. Speaker, these gains should not make us rest. This reminds us that growth in value does not automatically mean that physical production is secure.

**[04:40:14.830] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004151)  
This is a central challenge before us. How do we keep food affordable for Filipino families while making farming and fishing profitable enough for Filipino producers to remain in the sector?

**[04:40:25.740] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004152)  
The answer cannot be found in one commodity, one agency, or one program.

**[04:40:30.560] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004153)  
And it requires a complete value chain approach.

**[04:40:34.480] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004154)  
And this is why the 2027 budget must continue to protect the gains that we have now reached and must focus on investments that raise productivity, reduce cost, improve farm and fishery infrastructure,

**[04:40:47.520] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004155)  
minimize our post-harvest losses, strengthen our cold chain and logistics systems, expand market access, improve irrigation, modernize our fisheries,

**[04:40:58.880] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004156)  
strengthen animal health and biosecurity,

**[04:41:00.560] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004157)  
reduce smuggling, and make climate change resilience and disaster management and preparation part of every agricultural investment.

**[04:41:11.520] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004158)  
Mr. Speaker, the proposed DA budget is smaller than last year's allocation, but the responsibilities before the department have not decreased.

**[04:41:21.380] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004159)  
The department itself has emphasized that the 2027 budget must prioritize productivity, infrastructure,

**[04:41:29.520] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004160)  
post-harvest systems, market access, technology, climate change, adaptation and mitigation, disaster preparedness, and stronger agricultural and fisheries value chains.

**[04:41:44.020] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004161)  
The challenge before us, therefore, is not simply how much we appropriate.

**[04:41:48.620] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004162)  
It is how much value we create from every peso that we appropriated.

**[04:41:53.800] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004163)  
So every peso must translate into a hectare made more productive,

**[04:41:58.960] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004165)  
a fisherfolk family made more resilient,

**[04:42:03.240] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004166)  
Farmers and fisher folks' children able to go to school, a road that actually connects a farm to a market,

**[04:42:09.380] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004167)  
a crop saved from post-harvest loss, animals protected from disease, smugglers caught and prosecuted,

**[04:42:16.640] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004168)  
a farmer protected from disaster, and a Filipino family able to buy safe and nutritious food at a reasonable price.

**[04:42:27.080] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004169)  
So let us not go backwards.

**[04:42:29.520] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004170)  
From the gains of last year, instead, let us make the 2027 agricultural investment a forward-looking investment,

**[04:42:38.120] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004171)  
not merely in production, but in productivity, profitability, resilience, and food security.

**[04:42:46.540] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004172)  
And again, let us make our 2027 agriculture budget one that truly addresses poverty in the agricultural sector.

**[04:42:55.760] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004173)  
And let us make our budget able to entice younger people.

**[04:42:59.520] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004174)  
We wish to build an agricultural sector where fisher folks and farmers are not simply benefiting from government programs,

**[04:43:11.480] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004175)  
but competitive participants and self-investors in a modern and growing economy.

**[04:43:18.720] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004176)  
And ultimately, let us ensure that the measures of this budget will not just be an amount today, but an investment into the future.

**[04:43:29.520] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004177)  
So that we may have better harvests, higher income, lower losses, stronger rural communities, and more profitable farmers.

**[04:43:38.720] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004178)  
And may that we secure food supply that all Filipinos will be able to experience today and in the future.

**[04:43:46.920] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004179)  
And for these reasons, Mr. Speaker, I respectfully urge this honorable house to support the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Agriculture

**[04:43:58.520] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004180)  
and its attached agencies and corporations.

**[04:44:02.320] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004181)  
Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, at mabuhay po ang mga magsasakang Pilipino.

**[04:44:09.560] Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano** (asr-004182)  
Thank you, Honorable Bondoc. Majority Leader.

**[04:48:35.680] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004229)

Thank you, Mr. Speaker.

**[04:51:58.700] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004259)  
And that is really a major concern of the Department of Agriculture, is how to preserve the remaining agricultural lands.

**[04:52:05.640] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004260)

**[04:52:10.680] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004261)

**[04:52:14.960] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004262)  
One is to provide value to agricultural lands.

**[04:52:18.020] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004263)

**[04:52:26.300] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004264)

**[04:52:35.220] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004265)  
So number one is production and profitability.

**[04:52:38.460] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004266)  
So the DA is trying to increase its production, and hopefully also through reduction of post-harvest losses,

**[04:52:46.460] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004267)  
proper irrigation, support for fertilizers and pesticides, and the proper prices, farm gate prices,

**[04:52:56.300] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004268)  
then farmers will be able to make a living, and will not be tempted to sell their lots to speculators and developers.

**[04:53:04.460] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004269)  
Secondly, that's the approach towards the farmer.

**[04:53:07.180] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004270)  
There also needs to be an approach towards developers.

**[04:53:10.120] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004271)  
And one of the ways that the DA can do this is to work with the LGUs to discuss conversion.

**[04:53:15.660] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004272)  
There should be strict rules and guidelines, and if necessary, to even put conversion moratoriums,

**[04:53:23.880] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004273)

**[04:53:26.300] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004274)  
Convert.

**[04:53:27.340] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004275)

**[04:53:33.160] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004276)

**[04:53:35.160] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004277)

No.

**[04:56:30.980] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004302)

**[04:56:35.780] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004303)

**[04:57:18.000] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004308)

**[04:57:20.460] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004309)

**[04:57:24.380] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004310)  
So it's not that we're going to support them forever.

**[04:57:27.600] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004311)  
But the DA also has a framework upon which they get those cooperatives and irrigators associations which are not yet mature.

**[04:57:36.760] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004312)

**[04:57:48.000] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004314)

**[04:57:54.860] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004315)

**[04:58:11.740] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004316)  
So, yes, it's good that the DA is giving us subsidies and credit.

**[04:58:17.000] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004317)  
And together.

**[04:58:18.000] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004318)

**[05:00:46.260] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004340)  
There is only one answer to this.

**[05:00:48.760] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004341)

**[05:00:52.460] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004342)  
Di ba, there is a saying na,

**[05:00:54.680] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004343)

**[05:00:58.420] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004344)

**[05:01:01.680] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004345)

**[05:01:03.300] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004346)  
So there's only one answer actually to that.

**[05:01:05.700] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004347)  
And if it is profitable,

**[05:01:07.180] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004348)  
then therefore, so many people will rush there and start farming.

**[05:01:12.080] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004349)

**[05:01:16.120] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004350)

**[05:01:18.300] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004351)  
difficult access to direct buyers,

**[05:01:20.840] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004352)  
then there will not be enough persons

**[05:01:23.140] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004353)  
who want to enter,

**[05:01:24.380] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004354)  
who want to enter agriculture.

**[05:01:25.780] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004355)  
And secondly,

**[05:01:26.800] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004356)  
though I would say that profitability is the number one reason

**[05:01:29.840] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004357)  
that people would enter agriculture,

**[05:01:32.140] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004358)  
and there are so many ways to make this profitable.

**[05:01:34.760] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004359)  
One of these is through proper irrigation.

**[05:01:38.620] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004360)  
Dati po sa amin, we only used to have one cropping.

**[05:01:41.520] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004361)  
With the coming of the UPRIS,

**[05:01:42.980] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004362)  
the Upper Pampanga River Irrigation System,

**[05:01:45.740] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004363)  
they went from one cropping to three croppings.

**[05:01:50.200] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004364)  
So after that, so many people started to plant again.

**[05:01:53.320] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004365)  
So profitability,

**[05:01:54.920] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004366)  
but another reason that I would like to give you is culture.

**[05:01:58.260] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004367)  
We need to change the culture of Filipinos.

**[05:02:02.180] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004368)  
Farming is honorable,

**[05:02:03.420] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004369)  
farming is profitable,

**[05:02:04.960] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004370)  
at nakita po natin noong COVID-19,

**[05:02:07.440] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004371)  
sino ho ba ang sumikat kung hindi po mga magsasaka?

**[05:02:10.760] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004372)  
And there was even a saying on FB na,

**[05:02:13.440] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004373)  
eto po yung dumating na araw na mas mahalaga pala ang bukid kesa sa mall.

**[05:02:17.740] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004374)  
So we need also to change the culture.

**[05:02:19.840] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004375)  
Farming is not for persons who have not gone to school,

**[05:02:24.640] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004376)

**[05:02:28.100] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004377)  
Farming should be a first option of persons who own land.

**[05:02:31.540] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004378)  
To own land is to be a wealthy person

**[05:02:33.700] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004379)

**[05:02:37.280] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004380)

**[05:02:40.340] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004381)  
Kasi po, wala po kayong maipreprenda pag meron nung may sakit.

**[05:02:44.500] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004382)  
At wala po kayong, that farming in your land is an extra backup po sa pamilya.

**[05:02:51.180] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004383)  
So again, make it profitable.

**[05:02:54.380] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004384)  
And number two, make it honorable.

**[05:02:57.280] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004385)  
And you will have, do dumugin po tayo ng mga magsasaka.

**[05:03:00.920] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-004386)  
All below the age of 30.

**[05:03:03.780] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004387)  
Mr. Speaker, good sponsor.

**[05:03:15.340] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004390)

**[05:03:23.440] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004391)

**[05:03:33.180] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004393)

**[05:03:49.260] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004395)

**[05:03:54.020] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004396)  
Na may...

**[05:03:54.380] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004397)

**[05:03:55.940] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004398)

**[05:04:02.260] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004399)  
Yun naman po yung nakita natin, narinig din natin from the Department of Agriculture before

**[05:04:06.540] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004400)

**[05:04:13.940] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004401)  
Nonetheless, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, ang ending naman po nito ay kailangan po may pagbabago sa ating batas.

**[05:04:19.640] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004402)

**[05:04:24.380] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004403)

**[05:04:31.740] Rep. Renee Louise M. Co** (asr-004404)

**[05:47:32.260] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005279)

**[05:47:35.980] Rep. Presley C. De Jesus** (asr-005280)

**[05:47:46.500] Rep. Presley C. De Jesus** (asr-005281)

**[05:47:57.420] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005282)

**[05:48:09.360] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005283)

**[05:48:19.280] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005284)

**[05:48:26.220] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005285)

**[05:48:36.740] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005286)

**[05:48:43.180] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005287)

**[05:48:49.180] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005288)

**[05:51:16.980] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005318)

**[05:52:36.660] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005327)

**[05:52:40.180] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005328)

**[05:52:47.120] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005329)

**[05:52:49.580] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005330)

**[05:52:54.480] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005331)  
So despite the limited budget, ginagawa po nila yun.

**[05:52:57.640] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005332)

**[05:53:09.660] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005333)

**[05:53:16.240] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005335)

**[05:53:19.500] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005336)

**[05:53:22.580] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005337)

**[05:53:28.840] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005338)  
So despite their limited budget due to limited fiscal space,

**[05:53:36.680] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-005339)

Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor, I will now proceed with my questions na nais ipahatid ng aking colleague na si Representative Laila de Lima.

**[06:34:32.420] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006045)  
This is regarding the Fisheries Administrative Order 266, yung Vessel Monitoring System and Electronic Reporting System po.

**[06:34:41.780] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006046)  
Noong January 21 of 2026, dineklara ng Supreme Court en banc

**[06:34:46.960] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006047)  
na unconstitutional ang FAO 266 na nagresulta sa pag-invalidate ng Mandatory Vessel Monitoring System

**[06:34:56.760] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006048)  
at Electronic Reporting System requirements para sa mga commercial Philippine flag fishing vessels.

**[06:35:03.900] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006049)  
Ang tanong ko, since ang VMS at ERS ay mahalagang tools para mamonitor ang fishing activities at ma-deter ang illegal, unreported, and unregulated,

**[06:35:16.960] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006050)  
fishing, ano po ang naging kongkretong epekto ng Declaration of Unconstitutionality nito sa monitoring at enforcement efforts ng BFAR,

**[06:35:27.780] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006051)  
particularly sa pag-pigil ng illegal fishing at protekta sa marine resources at kabuhayan ng mga munisipal fisherfolk?

**[06:35:39.000] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006052)  
Mr. Speaker, despite the nullification of FAO 266, the BFAR continues to implement Vessel Monitoring,

**[06:35:46.960] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006053)  
where it is required under the Philippines' international fisheries obligations,

**[06:35:51.800] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006054)  
including it as a condition for access to the waters of other coastal states and to fishing grounds managed by the regional fishing management organizations.

**[06:36:02.880] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006055)  
So, yes, humina po ang BFAR's enforcement capabilities, but they are still doing their best po.

**[06:36:16.960] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006056)  
They retain alternative enforcement tools, including vessel inspection, sea patrol, onboard observers, etc.

**[06:36:24.940] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006057)  
Marami po silang ginagawa, so we are happy to share that with you, Mr. Speaker.

**[06:36:28.840] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006058)  
Following this ruling po, Madam Sponsor, ano po ang mga alternative systems o mechanisms na ginagamit ngayon ng BFAR to monitor fishing activities

**[06:36:38.620] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006059)  
at maisagawa ang mga functions na dating sinasaklaw ng VMS at ERS?

**[06:36:44.920] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006060)  
So, the following po, Mr. Speaker, are occurring even as we speak.

**[06:36:51.100] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006061)  
Mandatory deployment of the MCS patrol boats, physical vessel inspections, sea patrols, onboard observers, logbook audits, port controls, licensing, intelligence gathering, at marami pa pong iba.

**[06:37:05.160] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006062)  
Maraming salamat, Madam Sponsor.

**[06:37:07.340] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006063)

**[06:37:14.920] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006064)

**[06:37:22.080] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006065)  
And how many have...

**[06:37:23.000] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006066)  
Yung mga unregistered?

**[06:37:24.540] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006067)  
Yes po.

**[06:37:26.380] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006068)

**[06:37:32.840] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006069)  
Ito po, i-share ko na lang po, Mr. Speaker.

**[06:37:35.440] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006070)  
2025, 158, 2026, 76.

**[06:37:44.080] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006071)

**[06:37:44.920] Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula** (asr-006072)

**[06:37:56.720] Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.** (asr-006073)

**[08:22:00.420] Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella** (asr-008219)
